disqualifier.note: Independently observed WHATWG element facts. Write sites set them from ELEMENT_META tables; both-false is the common normal element, and readers use .void for end-tag omission and sibling textMode for parse/serialize mode rather than an exclusive void/rawText match.
WHATWG <audio> boolean attributes on the HTML AST overlay; independently present presence-booleans mirroring the spec, not a domain phase.
WHATWG <button> boolean attributes on the HTML AST overlay; independently present spec presence-booleans, not exclusive button phases.
WHATWG <form> boolean attributes; formnovalidate and novalidate are independently present spec tokens on the AST overlay.
WHATWG boolean attributes on the HTML AST overlay; independently present spec presence-booleans.
WHATWG <input> boolean attributes on the HTML AST overlay; independently present spec presence-booleans whose combinations are type-conditional in HTML, not a flattened domain state machine.
Obsolete WHATWG <marquee> boolean attributes on the HTML AST overlay; independently present spec presence-booleans.
WHATWG <object> boolean attributes on the HTML AST overlay; independently present spec presence-booleans.
compact is a legacy presentational toggle and reversed independently marks descending numbering; all four combinations are legal HTML.
Independent option facts: a selected option may also be disabled. Combined-true is legal HTML.
WHATWG <script> boolean attributes on the HTML AST overlay. async+defer may both be present in markup (browser priority, not a rejected combo); nomodule is an independent classic-vs-module axis.
WHATWG <select> boolean attributes on the HTML AST overlay; independently present spec presence-booleans.
WHATWG declarative-shadow-root boolean attributes on <template>; independently present spec presence-booleans, not exclusive shadow-root phases.
WHATWG <textarea> boolean attributes on the HTML AST overlay; independently present spec presence-booleans.
WHATWG <video> boolean attributes on the HTML AST overlay; independently present spec presence-booleans, not a playback-phase machine.
